meta.purpose: Records, as data, everything the CLI emulator deliberately does not implement. docs/NOT-EMULATED.md is generated from this file by scripts/generate-docs.mjs, and scripts/validate-docs.mjs fails if the two ever disagree.
meta.principle: The emulator is a bounded state machine sized to the shipped hands-on task set, not an IOS clone. Anything absent is declared here rather than silently unavailable, so no question can ever assume behaviour that does not exist.
meta.adoptVsBuild: Real Cisco IOS cannot run in a browser. containerlab, CML and GNS3 require Docker, which defeats a local-first browser tool. Build is correct for the bounded subset.
